name: buckspay

scripts.anchor:deploy:devnet: cd anchor && anchor build -- --features devnet && node scripts/check-program.mjs devnet && anchor program deploy --provider.cluster devnet --provider.wallet ~/.config/buckspay/deployer.json
scripts.anchor:deploy:localnet: cd anchor && anchor build -- --features devnet && node scripts/check-program.mjs devnet && anchor program deploy --provider.cluster localnet
scripts.anchor:setup: mkdir -p anchor/target/deploy && cp ~/.config/buckspay/buckspay-keypair.json anchor/target/deploy/buckspay-keypair.json && cd anchor && anchor keys sync && anchor build -- --features devnet && cd .. && pnpm run codama:js
scripts.ci: EXPO_OFFLINE=1 expo install --check && tsc --noEmit && pnpm run lint:check && pnpm run lint:kotlin && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run android:build && pnpm run test
scripts.codama:check: pnpm run codama:js && pnpm run codama:rust && git diff --exit-code -- anchor/target anchor/src/client/js/generated gateway/client/src/generated && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- anchor/target anchor/src/client/js/generated gateway/client/src/generated)"
scripts.codama:rust: codama run rust -c ./anchor/codama.mjs && cargo fmt --all --manifest-path gateway/Cargo.toml

description: Offline bearer payments on Solana for Android
